messages.subject: shrink.gbm
messages.body_plain: Does anyone use the shrink.gbm functions? So far as I can see they haven't worked for some time, and were experimental anyway? Should we just remove them?

messages.subject: Re: NAMESPACE
messages.body_plain:
First pass...

Defo in:

basehaz.gbm
gbm
gbm.fit
gbm.more
gbm.perf
plot.gbm
predict.gbm
pretty.gbm.tree
print.gbm
relative.influence
summary.gbm
interact.gbm

Defo out:
gbmCluster
gbmCrossVal
gbmDoFold
getCVgroup
getStratify
guessDist
reconstructGBMdata
Various other listed in gbm-internal.Rd

Some of those have help files, presumably because I wrote them to keep R CMD check happy. I think the help files can go and comments in the code explain what's going on.

Harry
